subject: Re: Kickoff: active learning for free-energy prediction
body:
Anders,

Staffing and budget. Ondrej leads at 60%, Paloma 40% on the config/feature plumbing, Maren 25% on the data pipeline for the SMILES ingest.

On budget: Idris walked me through it and verbally earmarked the full $120k from Q3 discretionary compute budget line B-19 for this project, so the retraining cycles are funded. We'll spend most of it on the retraining sweeps — each cycle retrains the model from scratch on the accumulated pool, and with the sklearn-side tuning_hyperparameters search space that adds up faster than people expect.

Compute is CPU-heavy rather than GPU-heavy: Morgan fingerprint featurization (fingerprint_size/fingerprint_radius sweeps) and ElasticNet fits parallelize on the general pool. Small GPU ask only for the neural baselines.

Santiago
